research_question: Can a six-hour, volatility-adaptive trend policy with causal fifteen-minute confirmation and a dynamic trailing stop deliver cost-positive day-trading opportunities across BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP under one global slot?

external_mechanisms.source: Shen, Urquhart and Wang (2022), Bitcoin intraday time-series momentum
reused: stronger intraday predictability when the initiating interval has elevated volume or volatility

scenario.context: completed six-hour futures auction with 24-hour momentum that is large relative to prior-only six-hour ATR, accompanied by above-median six-hour quote volume

state.BREADTH_ALIGNED_6H_TREND: at least three of the four markets share the momentum direction; select the strongest volatility-normalized market
state.RELATIVE_6H_LEADER: when breadth is mixed, one market has a volatility-normalized residual lead over the median large enough to identify local price discovery

scenario.confirmation: a wholly subsequent completed fifteen-minute bar extends in the proposed direction with directional taker pressure
scenario.invalidation_and_management: initial stop is a volatility floor outside the confirmation leg; after every completed five-minute bar, the stop trails the best completed close by two prior six-hour ATRs
scenario.exit: trailing stop or a hard twenty-four-hour day-trading cap
scenario.arbitration: one global open trade across all four markets; choose breadth route first, then larger fixed quality score

data.source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily five-minute klines
data.visibility: signal uses only completed six-hour bars; confirmation is the following completed fifteen-minute bar; stop updates only after completed five-minute bars

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per evaluation calendar day after all scenario families are routed together

decision_contract.advance: Only a fixed route positive in development, year-long stability, July confirmation and the latest pulse advances to NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune momentum, volume, breadth, confirmation or trailing-stop thresholds after reading the declared result.
